thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency SLO breach detected for dedicated-pool eu-west-2 (tailwind) - automatic page to #incidents oncall. p95 jumped from 220ms -> 860ms, p99 ~ 2.9s, streaming stall rate +18% in last 5m.
Oncall-SRE: acked. I'm on it, grabbing logs and starting triage.
Alex Chen: adding context — we've had a medium hotshot burst from a few large tenants with long seq lengths (~6k tokens) hitting dedicated pool. Queue depth spiked to 740 (threshold 200).
Maria Gomez: looks like autoscaler didn't add capacity fast enough; review shows handshake latency to pool manager spiked and the warmup job queued for ~45s before GPU activation.
Samir Patel: sharing quick trace excerpt:
```
[2026-03-15T12:03:17Z] autoscaler: request_scale(pool=eu-west-2, want=+6) -> enqueue
[2026-03-15T12:03:18Z] handshake: start -> 2400ms
[2026-03-15T12:03:18Z] warmup: begin -> cold_kv_load:true
[2026-03-15T12:03:58Z] warmup: completed -> ready_for_traffic
[2026-03-15T12:04:02Z] result: p99 spike observed
```
Irene K: pinging infra — is there any known NFS/volume attach slowness? warmup looks KV-coldpath heavy.
deploy-bot: note: recent change 1700e3b -> reduced handshake timeout from 60s to 30s (rolling). Might have reduced headroom for slow pools.
Oncall-SRE: observed handshake drift — some slot handshakes hit TCP retransmit / rpc retry and delayed container init. autoscaler metrics show avg scale-latency 65s (SLO 20s).
Alex Chen: customer impact: 4 priority tenants on Dedicated eu-west-2 saw streaming stalls (clients saw repeated RTT >2s and some gRPC stream resets). Estimated user-visible errors ~3.2% for those tenants in last 15m.
Maria Gomez: mitigations suggested: 1) manual add +4 hotshot slots to pool, 2) enable temporary fallback routing to small-quantized variant (model-sm-q4) for streaming sessions older than 2s, 3) throttle non-priority tenants to reduce queue pressure.
Samir Patel: running manual scale now: `rictl scale-pool --pool eu-west-2 --delta 4 --reason "tailwind surge emergency"`
Oncall-SRE: manual scale in flight. Also flipping on a temporary prefix-KV warm cache for the busiest tenants: `cachectl pin --pool eu-west-2 --tenants t-42,t-87` (5m).
Irene K: infra confirms an AZ-level attach latency spike at 12:01Z that maps to the warmup window. Storage team investigating; filing SEV to storage channel. Link: https://internal.storage/incidents/SEV-514
incident-bot: update: manual scale accepted, new slots starting -> expected ready ~35s
Alex Chen: runbook refs: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-tailwind (see section "handshake drift & rapid mitigation"). Also see playbook snippet for fallback routing.
Maria Gomez: telemetry update — after manual scale started, p95 down to 420ms but p99 still around 1.1s due to tail retries and a few streams that hit cold KV layer.
Samir Patel: to reduce cold-KV tail, recommending prefetch warmup for top N prefixes and raising warmup concurrency to 6 for 10m window. Command: `rictl warmup --pool eu-west-2 --prefetch-top 1000 --concurrency 6`
Oncall-SRE: applying throttles for non-priority tenants with `quotactl set-rate --pool eu-west-2 --label non-priority --rps 50` — doing soft throttling to avoid full outage.
Irene K: storage team says root cause is transient attach latency plus handshake retries amplifying autoscaler velocity. They suspect controller plane backpressure from a recent network config roll. Rolling back that config now.
Alex Chen: decision log: rollback network config (storage-side), manual scale +4, enable prefix warm cache, throttle non-priority, enable fallback to model-sm-q4 for new streaming sessions over 2s.
Maria Gomez: customer comms: pinged account execs for 4 tenants, asking to set expectation for degraded streaming quality ~20-40m window. Draft message posted to #customer-notify for review.
Samir Patel: post-mitigation telemetry (5m after): p95 ~260ms, p99 ~480ms, streaming stall rate down to +2% vs baseline. Queue depth back under 160.
Oncall-SRE: closing live mitigation phase. Assigning follow-up: create RCA ticket, include timeline and config rollback, storage team to own SEV-514, infra to add autoscaler headroom and increase handshake timeout in slow-pool path.
Irene K: note for follow-up: add a probe that simulates warmup with realistic KV loads to catch attach latency regressions during infra rollouts.
Alex Chen: thanks everyone. I'll own the RCA and follow up with a postmortem in 24h. If any regressions, reopen thread. :thumbsup:
